title: Unit 7: Capital Punishment
source: Henry's Gamma decks "M.3 Unit 7 Lesson 1, 2 and 4" (vocabulary, editorials, concession clauses). American spelling.

questions.q: Which word means "to officially end a law or system"?

Which word means "hurting someone because they hurt you"?
Which word means "fair treatment under the law"?
Which word means "causing serious pain or suffering on purpose"?
Which word means "the illegal and deliberate killing of a person"?
Which word means "deciding not to feel anger toward someone who hurt you"?
Which word means "a community of people who share laws and culture"?
Spell the word that means "using physical force that causes injury or death".
Spell the noun: "something a person is entitled to have or do". (Every person has a ___ to life.)

The jury found the defendant ___ and sentenced him to death.
Many human rights organizations ___ capital punishment.
Polls show that many Americans still ___ capital punishment.
Some victims' families believe in ___, even after a violent crime.
Opponents argue that every human life deserves basic ___.
Some people believe capital punishment is simply ___ dressed up as justice.
Capital punishment is usually kept for the most ___ crimes.

What is the opposite of guilty?
What is the opposite of support?
What is the opposite of forgiveness?
Justice is fair. Revenge is ___.

Which pair are antonyms (opposites)?
Write the opposite of "innocent".
___ capital punishment may deter crime, the evidence is far from clear.
Despite the fact ___ innocent people have been executed, some say the system can be fixed.
Granted ___ some crimes are horrific, this does not mean execution is the only answer.
When the concession clause comes FIRST, put a ___ after it.
A concession clause ___ that the other side has a point.
Which connector, in this unit, goes only at the BEGINNING of the sentence?
Capital punishment should be abolished, ___ it may satisfy the desire for justice.
Combine with "although": Capital punishment may reduce crime. / There is little reliable evidence that it does.
questions.answer: Although capital punishment may reduce crime, there is little reliable evidence that it does.

questions.q: To abolish something means to introduce a new law.
An innocent person has been found guilty of a crime.
Revenge means punishing someone because they harmed you.
To oppose something means to strongly disagree with it.
A violent crime is peaceful and causes no harm.
An editorial is a neutral news report.
A fact can be proved. An opinion cannot.
"Studies show…" is a signal word for an opinion.
"If even one innocent person has been executed, can we truly say the system is just?" This is a ___.
"…may satisfy the desire for revenge — but revenge is not justice." The — adds ___.
Mixing short and long sentences = varying sentence ___.
"Supported by millions and condemned by millions more, …" This sentence varies its ___.
Writing with only simple sentences sounds ___.

motions: Capital punishment should be abolished everywhere.
Some crimes are so violent that the criminal deserves to die.
Even a guilty person has the right to live.
The purpose of punishment is to protect society, not to get revenge.
A government should never have the right to take a life.
The risk of executing an innocent person is too high.
Forgiveness is more powerful than revenge.
Life in prison is a worse punishment than execution.
Victims' families should help decide the punishment.
Capital punishment stops people from committing crimes.
